summary: Liraasa 3.6, "The 2100 Dreams patch: robots, the mind, the neocity" (ADR-0027), from the author's 3.6 patch, every module installed. PROPOSED: PROPOSED: ratify tier 1 first; tier 2 may be ratified, deferred or dropped item by item. Additions only: 2 roots (kibo, garza), rulings 3.6:G153-G155 (renumbered past 3.5:G152); 146 compounds (lavipavma and sovepavma dropped for the copied scientific names, seven coinages for the novel's sound-words and slang), 10 listed derivations, 7 lexicalised diminutives, 1 restored forms and 59 English aliases, each entry noted with its tier and module. No 3.5 word, spelling or ruling changes.

rulings.ruling: Base units are compounds on patu: bondopatu (gram), lalnipatu (metre), mirupatu (litre). The diminutive -ti names the thousandth (milli-) and -vu the thousandfold (kilo-): bondopatuti milligram, bondopatuvu kilogram, lalnipatuvu kilometre. A numeral counts them: dossa bondopatuti, two milligrams. Body units (3.2:G144) remain the everyday, poetic measures.
3.3:G148 also applies to lexicalised diminutives: their -san form means 'of or marked by X'. mavofaruti (hypomania) gives mavofarutisan (hypomanic); vizudemroti (tic) gives vizudemrotisan.

Profanity is a register, not a grammar. garza is the all-purpose curse: the interjection Garza! (Fuck!, Damn!), the intensifier garzasan before a noun (fucking, damned), and the verb garzaga (to swear). rupu (waste) serves as Rupu! (Shit!). Insults are person-compounds on nela: rupunela, larnenela. Coarse words never take ascended forms, and are marked [coarse] in the lexicon.
examples: Li garzasan kibo po bakoba li tabu.
The damned bot broke the table.
